title: When You Do All That Work to Escape Police & Still Get Caught
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 23, 2022, a La Crosse County Sheriff’s deputy attempted to stop a vehicle for traffic violations in Bangor, WI. The driver allegedly fled at a high rate of speed, crashed, and disabled their vehicle. They fled on foot and were able to successfully escape law enforcement. Later in the day, a deputy happened to locate the same driver passing by him in a different vehicle while trying to obscure their face. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
